title: Signal: NuGet package declared with a version range
scope: A packages.config file that declares a package version written as a range.
limitations: It matches a package version written as a range in the parsed packages.config; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A packages.config that mentions a package version written as a range in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
